# Verndly

> Verndly (https://verndly.com) is Ghana's marketplace connecting buyers with verified independent businesses, brands, and young entrepreneurs.

All purchases on Verndly are protected by Paystack escrow settlement, offering a 7-Day Buyer Protection guarantee and fast local courier delivery.

## Core Features
- **Verified Independent Merchants**: Curated stores across Ghana (Accra, Kumasi, Takoradi, Tamale) offering authentic products.
- **7-Day Escrow Buyer Protection**: Online payments are held in escrow and only released to the seller after the buyer receives and inspects the item.
- **Paystack Payment Rails**: Full support for MTN Mobile Money, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo Money, Visa, Mastercard, and bank transfer.
- **Direct Storefronts**: Each verified seller operates an independent storefront accessible at `https://verndly.com/s/[store_link]`.
- **Courier Logistics**: Sellers dispatch with verified couriers providing same-day or 1-3 business day tracked delivery.

- Homepage & Featured Marketplace: https://verndly.com/

## Product Categories
- Electronics & Gadgets (Smartphones, Laptops, Accessories)
- Fashion, Clothing & Footwear
- Health, Beauty & Cosmetics
- Home, Furniture & Appliances
- Books & Stationery
- Groceries, Food & Snacks

## Buyer Protection & Refunds
- **Inspection Period**: 7 calendar days from delivery confirmation.
- **Eligible Reasons**: Damaged in transit, defective, materially different model/color, or non-delivery.
- **Refund Execution**: Automated Paystack gateway reversal directly to original Mobile Money or card account.
- **Dispute Escalation**: Independent administrative arbitration if buyer and merchant do not reach agreement within 48 hours.
